changelog: Intent-named entry for the existing Scavio skill
display_name: Google Hotels API - Hotel Search, Rates, Ratings, Amenities
summary: Google Hotels search for a destination and stay dates as structured JSON: properties with name, nightly rate and rating, then per-property detail with booking-site vendor prices. Filter by price, rating, hotel class, amenities and vacation rentals. 2 endpoints, 1 credit each.
